title: Change of Owner's Name and/or Address
heading: Changing the Owner's Name or Address
lead: Same owner, new registered name or address: tell the Registry in writing and we'll issue a new Certificate of Registration and CSR.
lead_check: the hero lead is ours, from the live text
body: Changes to the owner's registered details to be recorded in the Register are to be communicated in writing to the Registry in accordance with PPR01-C04 Checklist for Change of Owner, ensuring the agreement of any existing mortgagees as shown against the vessel.
On receipt of the required documentation and the appropriate fee, the Registry will issue a new Certificate of Registration and Continuous Synopsis Record (CSR).
outcome: A new Certificate of Registration and Continuous Synopsis Record (CSR)
needs: Written notice to the Registry of the change of the owner's name and/or address
Completed PPR01-C04 Checklist for Change of Owner
The agreement of any existing mortgagees shown against the vessel
